frontmatter.title: Proximity and Obligation
frontmatter.statement: How should distance weigh in giving, and what do givers choose when they see honest comparisons?
frontmatter.progress: Experimental evidence on how givers allocate with and without comparisons, alongside a clear account of the moral positions.
frontmatter.bounty: Unfunded. The Question Bounties program will attach prizes once it is funded.

subject.body:
## Why it matters

The [Proximity Pull](/diagnosis/proximity-pull/) is partly a moral question and partly an information gap. The information gap can be closed, and then we can see what people choose.

## Where to start

A scoped survey experiment could test how comparisons across distance affect choices, with its cost and limits stated. The moral side is mapped in the [Disagreement Register](/record/disagreements/).
